title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: goodwill waiver of a fee row
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the desk may waive one fee row as goodwill at the applicant's request. Only late declaration fee, amendment fee, re-review fee and withdrawal fee rows may be waived; the administration fee, the surcharges, misdeclaration penalties and inspection cost recovery are never waived. A waiver cancels the whole referenced row. The fee row's amount must not exceed the category's waiver authority. The customer's dangerous-goods goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days must be fewer than the category's waiver allowance. The waiver must be requested no later than the category's request window, in calendar days, after the fee being waived was booked: the window ends on the fee's charge date plus the category's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a request on the last day is inside it. Each fee row is waived at most once.

## Conditions checklist
| Test | Met when | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Kind of row | late declaration, amendment, re-review or withdrawal fee | the fee row |
| Authority | the row's amount does not exceed the category's authority | the fee row |
| Allowance | waivers counted below are fewer than the category's allowance | the customer's waiver entries |
| Window | the request falls on or before the last day of the window | the fee row's charge date |
| Once | the row has not been waived before | waiver entries referencing the row |

A waiver is not granted when the row's amount exceeds the authority or when the waivers counted reach the allowance.

## Counting waivers
The count covers the customer's goodwill waiver entries dated within the trailing 365 calendar days ending on the waiver date, inclusive, across all of the customer's acceptances.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures: authority 120.00, allowance 2, window 20 days)
- A fee row of 120.00 does not exceed 120.00 and is within authority; a row of 120.01 is not.
- One waiver already counted is fewer than 2; two already counted are not.
- Fee booked on 1 September: the window ends on 21 September. A request on 21 September is inside it; one on 22 September is not.

## Points of judgement
- *Can part of a fee row be waived?* No; a waiver cancels the whole referenced row.
- *Where the category's allowance is 0, can any waiver be granted?* No; no count of waivers is fewer than 0.
- *Where the category's authority is 0.00, is a positive fee row within it?* No; any positive amount exceeds 0.00.
